article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced a community event week, 'Job Sampling Week', in which staff met players at job trainers on consecutive days (Nov 9-13, 2009) to socialize, answer questions, trade equipment and duel. It covers jobs that were previously locked to free players (Archer, Wizard, Medic, Blacksmith, Warrior), with a meeting time and location for each day on Server 1.
